remarks: A very special home and location! This fabulous newly renovated 4 bedroom - 2 1/2 bath colonial split level has been completely updated and designed for indoor/outdoor entertaining, extended family, or working from home. With a blend of classic design, timeless appeal, modern amenities, and open concept this home is an ideal haven for creating lasting memories and enjoying family. The Main floor includes the living room and formal dining room with a central fireplace creating a welcoming atmosphere. From the living room is an updated country kitchen with light oak custom cabinetry and travertine tile backsplash. A few steps away is the entertaining area with family room, office/guest bedroom, full bath, mudroom, and sliders to the private backyard complete with stonewall and patio. The upper floor is custom designed for privacy with 3 bedrooms including a spacious private primary bedroom suite that offers an oversized walk in closet and full bath with custom cabinetry, separate shower, vintage tub, and washer and dryer. The additional two bedrooms have access to updated bath with double vanity and all bedrooms offer large windows, abundant closet space, and hardwood floors. Additional features include palladium windows, custom stonework and cabinetry, hardwood floors throughout, full basement, and attached garage. Minutes to E. Norwalk Train, I-95, Merritt Parkway, shopping/dining and walk to parks/playgrounds and schools.
